status: candidate engineering budgets fixed before sampling; not owner acceptance or production/SLA evidence
scope: Installed desktop Chrome155, headless1440x900, real native Nginx gzip/cache and isolated same-origin API over loopback; CDP fixed limits only. No TLS/DNS/packetloss/mobile/CPU emulation.

definitions.cold: Fresh browser context and empty HTTP cache; root entry to loaded welcome and usable controls.
definitions.warm: Same context/save/credential/book, native navigation back through root with HTTP cache enabled; root to welcome. Resume same guest and verify once.
definitions.httpBytes: Sum CDP loadingFinished encodedDataLength plus observed redirect bytes; HTTP-level browser counter, not physical TLS/IP bandwidth.
definitions.sampleStatistics: Raw samples and min/max only. Seven samples are not a p95 population or real-device performance proof.
